---
title: "Personal Visualization Journey"
---

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
PVJ_1_ <- read_excel("~/Downloads/PVJ (1).xlsx")

names(PVJ_1_)
```



```{r}

ggplot(PVJ_1_, aes(x = Day, y = Sleep, color = Exercise)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Exercise)) +
  labs(title = "How Rested I Felt After Gym vs. Volleyball",
       x = "Day of Experiment", y = "Sleep Quality (1-5)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
